root_cause: A step-splitting operation created sub-steps that inherited the parent's ID, then a later renumber pass assigned fresh sequential IDs but did not update the depends_on references that had been set against the old IDs. Dependencies silently pointed at unrelated steps.

details.rule: When renumbering a collection, update every reference to the renamed identifiers in the same atomic operation. Or use positional references that survive renumbering. Stale references that resolve to a valid but wrong target are worse than dangling references.
